subject: MSA & Order Form: confidentiality, case study and logo use
messages:
From: Tyler Shaw <tyler.shaw@clearwave.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA draft + publicity/case study requests

Markus —

Thanks for sending over the MSA and order form. We've attached our redlines (see Redlines_ClearWave_MSA_v3.docx) for confidentiality and publicity sections. Two quick asks from our side so we can keep the procurement window moving: 

- We need explicit permission to run a case study and use Redwood's logo on our website and presentations; preferred language is a general "reference and logo use" clause.
- We'd like a 30-day embargo from the date of signature before any joint press announcement.

Can your legal or marketing team confirm whether Redwood requires any additional approval steps beyond a written runbook? Also include any standard logo usage guidelines so our design team can prepare assets.

I can loop in our marketing lead if you want to propose copy.

Thanks,

Tyler Shaw
Strategic Sourcing
ClearWave Analytics

Attachments: Redlines_ClearWave_MSA_v3.docx, case_study_outline_draft.pdf

Elena / Tyler —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redlines. Looping in our legal lead (Laura) and head of marketing (Stephanie) to confirm:

- Redwood typically allows customer references and logo inclusion for marketing, but we require a simple approval step for any public-facing quote or case study.
- We can discuss embargo timing; Laura — can you take a look at the proposed 30-day window and the redline in the attachment?
- Stephanie — if we agree in principle, can you send a short logo usage spec and a template for co-branded releases so ClearWave's design team has what they need?

Deal id for internal tracking: RW-CLW-2027-Q3-42.

Next actions: Laura to propose language; Stephanie to provide logo spec. I will consolidate and send an updated snippet for Elena to confirm.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@clearwave.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA draft + publicity/case study requests

Hi all —

Thanks for the redlines. I took a first pass on the confidentiality/publicity sections and attached a marked-up doc (MSA_confidentiality_markup.docx). Key proposed edits in summary: 

1) Publicity/Reference Rights:
- Allow Redwood to include ClearWave in a customer list and to use ClearWave's logo for marketing, provided logo usage follows Redwood's brand guidelines and is non-misleading.
- Any quotes, case studies, or co-branded press releases require prior written approval from the customer (ClearWave). Approval should not be unreasonably withheld.

2) Embargo & Announcement Timing: 
- Propose a 45-calendar-day embargo from the effective date for joint public announcements instead of 30 days. Reason: internal legal + PR coordination often takes longer for enterprise customers; 45 days is standard for our higher-touch customers.

3) Approval SLA & Process: 
- To keep timelines tight, suggest a 5 business day review SLA for non-substantive marketing assets (logo placement, boilerplate copy) and 10 business days for substantive items (case studies with customer quotes). If either party needs more time, request they notify the other with written reasons.

4) Confidential Information carve-out: 
- Keep the standard definition of Confidential Information but allow for the above marketing uses provided the customer confirms any disclosed excerpts are not "Confidential Information" under the agreement.

If ClearWave is comfortable with the 45-day embargo and the approval SLAs above, I'll prepare a clean MSA snippet that we can insert into the redlines and circulate for signature.

Markus — Stephanie, I've cc'd marketing for the logo spec; Stephanie, please attach the logo guidelines and a simple sign-off form for approvals.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_confidentiality_markup.docx

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearwave.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tyler Shaw <tyler.shaw@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA draft + publicity/case study requests

Laura / Markus —

Thanks for the thorough review and the proposed language. ClearWave is agreeable to the following: 

- Accept the 45-day embargo as proposed.
- We agree to the approval SLA of 5 business days for minor assets and 10 business days for substantive case studies, as long as Redwood commits to providing materials for review promptly (we will aim to return approvals within the SLA).
- We will confirm logo usage is limited to the customer list and case study contexts; our design team will review Redwood's logo spec.

Please send the clean MSA snippet for insertion into the draft and a DocuSign envelope when ready; procurement is standing by.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
VP, Marketing Operations
ClearWave Analytics
